title: analytical_feature
description: Family B — the market-side cell. What the market is doing. Independent rollup keyed on the grain (WSB-hot ∪ screener movers); joined to empirical_feature via full outer join in `signal`. See data-dictionary.md §4 and data-model.md §5.3.

ticker.description: Whitelist-validated symbol; must exist in instrument.

window_start.description: Inclusive lower bound of the half-open window [window_start, +len(resolution)).

resolution.description: Window length. 1h is the v0.0.1 primary.

coverage_scope.description: Why this ticker has a market row: wsb_hot (top-N by H_e) ∪ screener_mover (market-wide, no WSB heat → STEALTH candidate, no empirical row). Makes analytical_feature INDEPENDENT of empirical_feature, not a subset.

ret.description: Window-aligned return close(W)/close(W−1)−1 at this resolution. v0.0.1 approximates with a day-to-date return (latest−prev_close)/prev_close until intraday bars are stored — a daily value repeated across intraday cells. H_m uses |ret|.

realized_vol.description: Stdev of returns over trailing n. Used to express moves in vol-units (|ret|/realized_vol).

rvol.description: Relative Volume — the market twin of sov/z: vol(T,W) / avg_vol(T, trailing-N same session). 1 = normal. The key 'is the market reacting?' metric.

rvol_conf.description: Confidence in rvol, set by feed: free IEX (~2.5% of volume) → low; paid SIP/IBKR full volume → high.

pcr.description: Put/Call ratio: put_vol / call_vol. <1 = call-heavy (typical WSB bullish lotto). A market cross-check on community net_dir.

iv_rank.description: Percentile of at-the-money IV vs trailing ~1y. Level-independent 'is IV high?'. Rising iv_rank + call-heavy = the WSB fingerprint.

iv_skew.description: IV(OTM puts) − IV(OTM calls) (e.g. 25-delta). Crash-fear vs call-chase.

uoa.description: Unusual options activity: contract vol / OI ≫ 1 → fresh speculative positioning.

breadth.description: Dispersion of volume across the (strike × expiry) grid. Simple (P2): breadth_strikes count. Principled (P4): normalized entropy ∈ [0,1]. Low = fragile concentrated lotto; high = broad positioning.

h_m.description: Market Heat — composite 'how hard the market is actually moving it'. v0.0.1: {|ret|, rvol}. Quality scales with feed (see rvol_conf) + options availability.

as_of.description: Observation time of the market read — so a t=0 mention spike is never aligned to stale prices.
